comments.text: There is a live volcano under the waters of Turtle Island. The island is off the coast of Yi-lan, a few kilometers away. The volcano is only 30 to 60 meters deep. SCUBA divers can explore the area.

comments.author: @terraatlasofficial
comments.text: What stuck with me was Yushan at 3,950 metres — the tallest mountain in the western Pacific — and that only about 4.2% of Taiwan's people live in the east because the mountains run the whole length of the island. The contrast between that rugged spine and the crowded western plains really came through.
